items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And Buster Smith, one of his saxophonists retained the band in Oklahoma City. I don't know who he had in the band.

ctx.x: '41. So first thing off the bat, I got a job before I could deposit my transfer, with Stuff Smith. At Kelly's Stables. Then I worked with Frankie Newton.
Had you been acquainted with Smith before, or did they know you by reputation, or what?
